definitions.current: type and endpoints only; no current amount
definitions.formula: Number of prior W2W edges receiver(T)->sender(T) in (t-7d,t], with key < key(T). Zero for non-W2W or self-loop.
definitions.meaning: Repeated reverse-direction relationships beyond the selected shortest path
definitions.name: candidate_prior_reciprocal_count_7d
definitions.non_oracle: No current/edge amount gates, no multi-edge qualifying-path conjunction or target.
definitions.prior: observable directed edges, strictly smaller timestamp/integer-ID keys
definitions.zero_missing: zero means no reciprocal edge or non-applicable role; no missing marker

definitions.formula: Count edge-pairs r->m and m->s with three distinct nodes, both in (t-7d,t], key(edge1)<key(edge2)<key(T). Each edge-pair counts once. Zero for non-W2W/self-loop.
definitions.meaning: Multiplicity of short return routes, not restricted to the selected path
definitions.name: candidate_prior_two_hop_return_count_7d
definitions.non_oracle: No monetary filtering, current return ratio, lengths 3..5 or complete cycle predicate.
definitions.prior: observable edges with increasing full keys
definitions.zero_missing: zero when no chronological two-edge route; no missing marker

definitions.current: type/endpoints select the prior path; current amount excluded
definitions.formula: max_j abs(log(amount(edge[j+1])/amount(edge[j]))) over adjacent edges in the Stage 10A selected chronological simple path of 1..5 prior edges. One-edge path=0; absent/non-W2W=-1.
definitions.meaning: Continuous value variation along a selected prior path
definitions.name: candidate_selected_path_max_log_value_change
definitions.non_oracle: No amount-gated path search, predicate cutoffs, current ratio gate or any-qualifying-path output.
definitions.prior: Stage 10A topology selection: shortest path, latest first edge, then lexicographic edge-key sequence
definitions.zero_missing: one-edge path has no adjacent discrepancy (0); absent path uses -1

definitions.current: current agent service/type; no cash principal assigned to W2W
definitions.formula: Cash-In plus Cash-Out service count / all service-event count in (t-24h,t], including permitted current service. Assisted W2W only enters denominator.
definitions.meaning: Cash activity relative to all agent service activity
definitions.name: candidate_agent_cash_service_share_24h
definitions.non_oracle: No cash-count minimum, unique-wallet count, direction thresholds or complete imbalance conjunction.
definitions.zero_missing: zero without agent/services; no missing marker

definitions.formula: abs(sum(skew_j)/4), where skew_j=(cashout_value-cashin_value)/(cashout_value+cashin_value) in each of four disjoint 6h buckets (t-(j+1)*6h,t-j*6h], j=0..3; empty-cash bucket skew=0. Current service enters j=0.
definitions.meaning: Persistence of a common cash direction across time, discounted by inactive buckets
definitions.name: candidate_agent_cash_direction_persistence_24h
definitions.non_oracle: No complete A4 count, wallet breadth, magnitude/change or current-role conjunction.
definitions.prior: same-agent history, key < key(T); no future buckets
definitions.zero_missing: zero with no cash/agent or balanced opposing bucket directions; no missing marker

definitions.baseline: at least 12 baseline services and 8 baseline cash events, full 29d observation; no recent eligibility gate
definitions.current: current cash value included; assisted W2W contributes zero cash
definitions.formula: Recent 24h Cash-In+Cash-Out minor-unit value / max(1, preceding disjoint 28d cash value / 28). Baseline B=(t-29d,t-1d], recent R=(t-1d,t].
definitions.meaning: Unsigned cash magnitude relative to the agent own earlier activity
definitions.name: candidate_agent_cash_value_acceleration_24h
definitions.non_oracle: No signed imbalance/change gates, recent count/breadth conjunction, private activation or predicate outcome.
definitions.prior: same-agent observed services; full baseline coverage from first observed service <=t-29d
definitions.zero_missing: -1 without agent or eligible baseline; valid zero if no recent cash; denominator floor one minor unit

temporal_rule: Strict timestamp/integer ID keys; open lower windows; fresh state; emit before update; observable eight-field projection only.
